description.en: Editor and mission framework for custom battles: place your own designs or the game's tanks and AT guns, give them paths, targets and reserves, add zones, mines, obstacles, rules and artillery, film a keyframed multi-camera cinematic, and command or take over any tank in the battle. Bundles Map Framework, which opens Ambush, The Crossroad, Silent Border and Sandbox to custom battles. Alpha.
description.zh: 自定义战斗的编辑器与任务框架：布置自己的载具或游戏自带的坦克与反坦克炮，为它们设置路径、目标与预备队，添加区域、地雷、障碍、规则与炮火支援，用关键帧多机位拍摄过场，并可在战斗中指挥任意坦克或接管驾驶、炮塔与火炮。内含 Map Framework，让 Ambush、The Crossroad、Silent Border 与 Sandbox 可用于自定义战斗。Alpha 阶段。
